# connectracer_connect_app_integration (Resource)

Manages an AWS AppIntegrations Application resource.

This creates an Application (e.g., an MCP Server integration) that can then be associated with an Amazon Connect instance using the `connectracer_connect_integration_association` resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_url` (String) The URL to access the application (the external URL source).
- `name` (String) The name of the application.
- `namespace` (String) The namespace of the application.

### Optional

- `application_type` (String) The type of the application. Valid values: `STANDARD`, `SERVICE`, `MCP_SERVER`.
- `description` (String) The description of the application.
- `permissions` (List of String) The configuration of events or requests that the application has access to.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to apply to the application.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the application.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the application.
